concept: AI matches described family (number/age of children, balcony vs yard, region) to a real koinobori (carp streamer) set size and order for Children's Day (Kodomo no Hi, May 5), explaining the meaning of each carp color and the accompanying yagura/fukinagashi.

AI matches described trip context (tattoos, travel companions, preferences) to the right real type of Japanese hot spring (rotenburo, uchiyu, ashiyu, konyoku) and explains genuine bathing etiquette rules so first-time visitors don't commit a faux pas.

AI matches a described mending/decorating need and skill level to a real traditional sashiko stitch pattern (moyo-zashi, hitomezashi, kogin-zashi), explaining its regional origin and step-by-step guidance.
AI matches described occasion, hair length, and kimono/yukata color to a real traditional kanzashi (hair ornament) style, explaining its seasonal motif and how it is traditionally worn.
